GUYN3C.player: What are the instructions for using the skullball course?

GUYN3C.npc: The skullball comes out of one of these four spawnholes. Just kick the ball through the middle of each goal, through the skeleton's feet.
There are 10 goals, which you must complete in order, and one final goal.
An arrow will point to your ball, just in case lots of people are using the course at the same time as yourself.
The better your time, the more agillity XP you will be awarded. The timer starts when you score your first goal.
